newsitem.title: ITALY: Olympia photo agency buys Publifoto from Olivetti.
newsitem.headline: Olympia photo agency buys Publifoto from Olivetti.

text.p: Fotocronache Olympia, one of Italy's best known photographic agencies, has bought the Publifoto photo archive from the Olivetti group's Interactive Telemedia unit, a company source said.
The value of the deal was not disclosed.
The two photo archives between them have around 15 million photographs covering Italian history from the 1930s to date.
Olympia was founded in the 1960s by current chairman Walfrido Chiarini. Publifoto was set up in 1937 by Vincenzo Carrese.
